product.name: Onsite Pro Pricebooks
product.description: Digital pricebooks for HVAC distributors that provide dealers with detailed product information, pricing, availability, and AHRI matchups to facilitate accurate quoting and proposal creation.

product.name: Onsite Pro Proposal Builder
product.description: A step-by-step digital tool that enables HVAC dealers to create professional sales proposals quickly using integrated product data, pricing, incentives, and financing options.

product.name: Margin Manager
product.description: A pricing tool within Onsite Pro that helps dealers set and manage job pricing based on gross margin targets, labor rates, and payment options to maintain profitability.

product.name: CRM and Sales Analytics
product.description: Integrated tools for tracking proposal history, managing sales opportunities, and analyzing key sales performance metrics within the Onsite Pro platform.
